description: Has Lokuli phone local service businesses near a US zip code (anywhere in the US) to ask whether they can do a job at the day and time the user wants, and what they'd charge. Lokuli first texts the user a confirmation link; calls start only after they tap it, and prices come back to them by text. Calls go out Monday–Saturday, 11am–6pm local time; a request made outside those hours waits for the next opening. Requires the service, the 5-digit zip, the day and time, and the user's US mobile number. Free for the user. A service that starts with the word "test" (for example "test house cleaning") sends the text and link but calls no business.

business.description: Optional: the slug of a business to call first, then nearby pros

date.description: The day they want, YYYY-MM-DD (today through 60 days ahead)

details.description: Anything a shop needs to quote: size, make/model, problem (optional)

phone.description: The user's US mobile number; the confirmation link and the prices are texted here

service.description: What they need, in plain words: "house cleaning", "brake repair", "plumber for a leaking water heater"

time.description: The time they want that day, like "10:00 AM" or "14:30"

zip.description: 5-digit zip code where the service is needed

name: request_quotes
title: Get prices from local pros
